title: Increasing Supplier Costs
description: Your supplier suddenly increases the price of raw materials.
question: How would you maintain your profit margin without losing customers?
npcAnswer: I would negotiate with the supplier, compare alternative suppliers, and review operational costs while maintaining product quality.

title: Declining Sales
description: Your business experiences a significant decline in sales.
question: What strategies would you introduce to attract more customers?
npcAnswer: I would introduce promotional campaigns, improve customer engagement, and analyse customer preferences to improve our products.

title: Customer Complaints
description: Several customers complain about the quality of your products.
question: How would you handle the complaints and restore customer trust?
npcAnswer: I would investigate the complaints, improve quality control, offer appropriate solutions, and communicate transparently with customers.

title: Business Competition
description: A new competitor opens a business offering similar products at lower prices.
question: How would you keep your business competitive?
npcAnswer: I would differentiate my products, improve customer service, and introduce competitive pricing without compromising quality.

title: Limited Business Capital
description: Your business has limited funds to expand its operations.
question: How would you manage your available capital and prioritise business growth?
npcAnswer: I would prioritise essential expenses, monitor cash flow, and invest in activities that provide the highest business value.

title: Supply Chain Disruption
description: Your business experiences unexpected supply disruptions.
question: How would you maintain business operations when your usual supplies are unavailable?
npcAnswer: I would identify alternative suppliers, prioritise essential inventory, and communicate with customers about any delays.

title: Viral Marketing
description: Your product suddenly becomes popular online.
question: How would you manage the sudden increase in customer demand?
npcAnswer: I would monitor inventory, organise additional production capacity, and maintain consistent product quality while responding to customers.

title: Natural Disaster
description: A natural disaster affects your business operations.
question: What steps would you take to minimise disruption and recover your business?
npcAnswer: I would prioritise safety, assess business losses, communicate with stakeholders, and develop a recovery plan.

title: Halal Certification
description: Your business needs to address certification requirements.
question: How would you prepare your business to meet the required certification standards?
npcAnswer: I would review the certification requirements, improve relevant business processes, prepare documentation, and seek guidance from the appropriate authorities.

title: Sustainable Production
description: Your business must reduce production waste.
question: How would you reduce waste without significantly increasing operating costs?
npcAnswer: I would review production processes, reuse suitable materials, improve inventory planning, and monitor resource consumption.

title: Business Sustainability
description: Your business must balance profitability and sustainability.
question: How would you maintain profitability while adopting more sustainable business practices?
npcAnswer: I would identify cost-effective sustainable practices, reduce unnecessary resource usage, and communicate the long-term benefits to customers.
